name: PEPFAR Active Patients in Care
description: Patients that are Active in Care in a facility in a particular period of time using the PEPFAR Lost to Followup Definition of 28 days

baseCohortDefinition.name: Active patients with PEPFAR LTFU as 28 days

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT pp.patient_id FROM patient_program pp WHERE pp.program_id = (SELECT program_id FROM program WHERE uuid = 'da5a7e66-1d5f-11e0-b929-000c29ad1d07') AND pp.voided = 0 AND (pp.date_enrolled <= :endDate) AND (pp.date_completed IS NULL OR pp.date_completed > :endDate OR DATEDIFF(:endDate, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(encounter_datetime) FROM encounter WHERE patient_id = pp.patient_id AND encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0), pp.date_enrolled)) <= 28)

SELECT date_enrolled FROM patient_program WHERE program_id = (SELECT program_id FROM program WHERE uuid = 'da5a7e66-1d5f-11e0-b929-000c29ad1d07') AND patient_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY date_enrolled ASC LIMIT 1
